correctness.rationale: For each n>=3, nonnegative rational barycentric weights on signed path roots sum to one; direct all-index tridiagonal multiplication yields supporting scalar products h_j between zero and lambda, with equality precisely at positively weighted roots. The residual thereby has nonpositive inner product with z-q for every surviving vertex, a complete projection certificate. Squared norms are exactly 1/2,4/5,9/10,11/12; equality roots are affinely independent and q lies in their relative interior. Cycle symmetry proves the equal all-vertex robustness; convexity of distance proves directed Hausdorff equality. All infinite quantifiers follow from the explicit symbolic path formula; finite tests are only corroborative.

value.rationale: Vertex-to-remaining-hull margin is an independently motivated geometric stability invariant in vertex enumeration. The theorem computes it for the canonical cycle symmetric-edge family and proves that the exact Euclidean distance and its entire nearest supporting face stabilize after the smallest possible nontrivial size n=6. Sharp all-dimensional cutoff, finite support localization to four roots, and full nearest-face classification are structural properties beyond an ad hoc finite calculation.
